platform: VeriProof Secure Digital Document Verification Platform

status_definitions.READY_FOR_EXPERIMENTS: Dataset files are present on disk, integrity verified, license permits experimental development, and task semantics are aligned.
status_definitions.RESTRICTED: Dataset is technically verified, but legally or operationally restricted (e.g. non-commercial research license or enterprise data privacy constraint).
status_definitions.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset is technically verified, but third-party commercial/intellectual property terms require formal legal verification before production packaging.
status_definitions.NOT_READY: Dataset directory is missing, files are unpopulated, or critical dependencies are absent.

CASIA2.name: CASIA 2.0
CASIA2.status_reason: Technically fully validated and ready for image tampering experiments, but legally restricted to non-commercial academic research.
CASIA2.provenance: CASIA NLPR (Dong et al., 2013) + Nam Thanh Pham et al. (2019) + SunnyHaze (2024)
CASIA2.license: Non-commercial academic research use only. Citation required.
CASIA2.label_definitions: Au = Authentic natural photography; Tp = Tampered (copy-move / splicing) natural photography; Gt = pixel-level binary tampering mask
CASIA2.label_provenance: Dong et al. (2013) initial dataset; binary ground-truth masks reconstructed algorithmically by Pham et al. (2019) and repaired by SunnyHaze (2024)
CASIA2.intended_use: Benchmark low-level image manipulation detection, noise inconsistency, splicing localization, and Error Level Analysis (ELA)
CASIA2.known_limitations: Photographic images of nature/scenes only. Contains zero academic degrees or identity documents. Labels must not be conflated with credential fraud.
CASIA2.leakage_risk: High source-donor leakage risk: spliced images derived from authentic donors must be grouped into the same split.

IDSpace.name: IDSpace
IDSpace.status_reason: Permitted preview subset (ALB scan, 30 images) is fully validated and ready for synthetic document manipulation experiments under CC-BY-4.0 license.
IDSpace.source_archive_sha256: Remote Hugging Face preview shard (verified 8,081,245 B)
IDSpace.label_definitions: positive = genuine synthetic ID scan; fraud_inpaint_and_rewrite = text erasure & replacement; fraud_crop_and_replace = portrait replacement
IDSpace.label_provenance: Procedural synthesis labels generated by IDSpace generative framework
IDSpace.intended_use: Identity document layout analysis, text inpainting detection, portrait replacement verification
IDSpace.known_limitations: Currently only a small 30-image Albanian preview subset is downloaded. Not sufficient alone for full training. Represents European IDs only, NOT Indian educational certificates.
IDSpace.leakage_risk: Template leakage risk: multiple documents share identical layout templates and must be grouped by template across splits.

FUNSD.name: FUNSD
FUNSD.status_reason: Technically complete and fully verified for OCR/layout experiments, but commercial usage terms for underlying Tobacco-800 scans require legal review.
FUNSD.provenance: Guillaume Jaume et al. (ICDARW 2019), EPFL / CRC Research
FUNSD.license: Research evaluation use; underlying documents derived from Tobacco-800 collection
FUNSD.label_definitions: Form entity classes: header, question, answer, other; word bounding boxes; directed entity linking graph. NO fraud labels.
FUNSD.label_provenance: Manual expert annotations for ICDARW 2019 Form Understanding competition
FUNSD.intended_use: Document OCR transcription benchmark, key-value pair extraction, spatial bounding box regression
FUNSD.known_limitations: Scanned administrative tobacco business forms. Contains zero authenticity or fraud labels. Must not be used for tampering classification.
FUNSD.leakage_risk: Test contamination risk: the 50 official test documents must remain strictly sequestered; zero tuning permitted.

Synthetic.name: Synthetic Datasets
Synthetic.status_reason: Fully generated, reproducible with fixed seeds (42071 / 98123), 100% privacy-safe, with zero PII and perfect mask/crypto validation.
Synthetic.source_archive: Generated procedurally via Pillow and Cryptography libraries
Synthetic.license: Internal VeriProof Platform (Permissive Internal / MIT / Apache 2.0)
Synthetic.label_definitions: Document-level authentic vs tampered; OCR consistent vs benign noise vs suspect; behavioral anomalies; crypto assertions
Synthetic.label_provenance: Ground-truth parameters known by procedural construction
Synthetic.intended_use: End-to-end algorithmic development across forensic features, OCR cross-validation, and behavioral anomaly detection
Synthetic.known_limitations: Procedural digital rendering does not simulate physical paper substrate, microprinting, or UV marks. Balanced fraud distribution does not reflect real-world <1% prevalence.
Synthetic.leakage_risk: Prevented: Training and model evaluation sets use strictly disjoint group IDs (170 train groups vs 50 eval groups, 0 overlap).

Neon_Derived.name: Neon-Derived Datasets
Neon_Derived.status_reason: Read-only schema inventory (93 columns), sanitized issuer state (1 row), and audit event aggregates (5 rows) are exported and valid, but live certificate registry extraction is paused (registered_documents has 0 rows).
Neon_Derived.provenance: VeriProof Cloud Database (session constraint: SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY)
Neon_Derived.license: Proprietary VeriProof Enterprise Data / GDPR & DPDP Compliant
Neon_Derived.label_definitions: Database lifecycle state (organizations.status = ACTIVE); audit event counts by hourly window
Neon_Derived.label_provenance: Directly from database schema and immutable audit log
Neon_Derived.intended_use: Registry schema validation, issuer lifecycle tracking, platform event monitoring
Neon_Derived.known_limitations: registered_documents and forensic_analyses tables currently contain 0 records. Production registry ML training must await operational certificate traffic.
Neon_Derived.leakage_risk: Prevented: coarse temporal truncation and platform-level aggregation prevent user trajectory linkage.
